title: A player for a personal music collection
description: Files from the storage you choose are available, with the download state made clear.

blocks.text: Rare versions and your own recordings may be stored outside the streaming catalog. The user needs one single path to listening.

quote.text: I store music on OneDrive to make it easily accessible from many devices. This app makes it really easy to make playlists and download the files for offline listening. The CarPlay integration works perfectly as well. Exactly what I was looking for.

blocks.text: Support specific formats and sources, and show the local copies. Keep the album order, the queue and the position.
Test large collections and the absence of a connection. A file name in the list should not mean it is already ready to play without a network.
